migration_details:
Migration path: currently on an OpenAI-compatible vendor. Plan is staged:
  1) Hosted API POC using Redwood's OpenAI-compat endpoint and a compatibility layer to validate prompt parity and streaming behavior.
  2) Run traffic replay and an automated regression suite (ROUGE/BLEU + human spot checks) over 2 weeks. Identify differences in tokenization, stop tokens, default sampling and reranker scoring.
  3) If parity within thresholds, provision Dedicated reserved pod for pilot (canary routing for 5% of production traffic).
  4) Full migration with routing policy + automatic fallback to incumbent provider for any detected regression.
Risks: KV-cache semantics differences, subtle tokenization mismatch causing summarization drift, cost delta on long-context workloads. Ask: engineering support from Redwood for prompt parity tuning, and a written fallback SLA for regressions.
